Jora Ward relaxes her stance fractionally, though her eyes remain fixed on the viewport. "The integrity is maintained," she confirms through the comms, a grudging acknowledgment of your tactical choice.

The perfect evolution simulation within its core loop has finished, but it did not end in stasis—it ended in adaptation. Dr. Ren’s console suddenly emits a violent spike of warning data that overrides all other alarms.
